Class ConceptMapExtensions

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.support.map.ConceptMapExtensions
public final class ConceptMapExtensions extends Object
The IPF extensions on a ConceptMap, in one place, so that ConceptMapLoader and ConceptMapWriter agree on their URLs and shapes.

They are plain extensions rather than a HAPI custom resource class on purpose: all of them sit on backbone elements - group and group.unmapped - and typing those would mean redeclaring ConceptMap's own group child with a different component type, which fights the base structure for no gain. Typed accessors over the standard model give the same safety at the only two call sites that need it.

They exist because the mapping model has four things ConceptMap has no field for. Everything else - the codes, the code systems and the equivalences - is native.

Since:
6.0

  • Field Details

    • MAPPING_NAME

      public static final String MAPPING_NAME
      On group, valueString: the name to register the mapping under. Without it a mapping is named after the resource, which cannot distinguish several groups.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • REVERSIBLE

      public static final String REVERSIBLE
      On group, valueBoolean: whether a reverse index is built at all. A group that is not reversible may map several codes onto one target without declaring how they differ.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • REVERSE_UNMAPPED

      public static final String REVERSE_UNMAPPED
